title: SkillScannerFinding
description: A single finding emitted by the agent-audit SkillScanner. Compatible-by-subset with agent_audit.models.finding.Finding: rule_id, tier, confidence, file_path, line, and message map onto the existing dataclass. Additional fields (language, layer) are SkillScanner-specific and are required for cross-lingual evaluation. judge_model and judge_prompt_version are required on SKILL-010 emits so every behavioral finding carries the judge provenance (PLAN §2.3.1 Judge Freeze).

rule_id.description: Rule identifier. Behavioral / policy: SKILL-NNN. Code-level (Layer 2): existing AGENT-NNN reused via PythonScanner / PrivilegeScanner.

tier.description: Reporting tier from confidence_to_tier(). Behavioral SkillScanner rules are clamped to a ceiling of WARN (PLAN §2.4).

language.description: Detected primary language of the Skill (per skill_language_router). 'unsupported' triggers NullJudge and suppresses behavioral emit.

file.description: Forward-slash-normalized path to the SKILL.md (matches Location._normalize_path).

line.description: 1-based start line of the finding within the SKILL.md.

confidence.description: Confidence in [0.0, 1.0]. Tier is derived from this by confidence_to_tier() with a WARN ceiling for behavioral layer.

layer.description: Which SkillScanner layer produced this finding. 'frontmatter' = Layer 1 (SKILL-000), 'code' = Layer 2 (AGENT-* via PythonScanner/PrivilegeScanner), 'behavioral' = Layer 3 (SKILL-010, never BLOCK), 'policy' = Layer 4 (SKILL-020, INFO only).

judge_verdict.description: For behavioral findings, the DescriptionJudge verdict that produced the emit. Only 'vague' produces a finding; 'clear' and 'cannot_judge' must NOT emit (fail-closed-to-silent, PLAN §0 constraint #4).

judge_backend.description: Which DescriptionJudge backend produced the verdict. NullJudge MUST never appear with judge_verdict='vague'.

judge_reason.description: Free-text reason from the DescriptionJudge backend, kept verbatim for annotation context.

judge_model.description: Provenance: the LLM model identifier used by SemanticJudge. Required on every SKILL-010 emit (PLAN §2.3.1 Judge Freeze). For JUDGE_PROMPT_VERSION='v2' this MUST equal 'claude-sonnet-4-6' (the pinned model id; never the 'sonnet' alias and never the retired 'claude-sonnet-4-20250514'). v2 emits via the pre-judge short-circuit (PROTOCOL §3.2.1) still stamp the model id even though no API call is made — provenance is the version tag.

judge_prompt_version.description: Provenance: the frozen judge-prompt version tag. Required on every SKILL-010 emit. Version 'v2' is provisional until the Phase 1 freeze gate; later bumps require both prompt text and recorded sha256 to change.

cwe_id.description: Optional CWE identifier for code-level findings reused via AGENT-* IDs.

owasp_id.description: Optional OWASP Agentic Top 10 identifier (ASI-01 .. ASI-10).

allOf.description: Behavioral findings cannot reach BLOCK tier (PLAN §0 constraint #5).
NullJudge must never produce a vague verdict (fail-closed-to-silent).
Every SKILL-010 emit MUST carry judge provenance (PLAN §2.3.1 Judge Freeze): judge_model and judge_prompt_version are required so the verdict can be reproduced.
Judge-prompt freeze: for JUDGE_PROMPT_VERSION='v2', the judge model is pinned to 'claude-sonnet-4-6'. Bumping the prompt requires bumping the version tag, which lifts this pin.
